title: Synthetic Data Generation
summary: A web application (with a Vercel-hosted frontend and Flask-style backend) that lets users upload tabular data and generate a synthetic version of it. Its Backend/app.py builds an SDV SingleTableMetadata schema, fits an SDV GaussianCopulaSynthesizer on the uploaded data, samples synthetic rows, and scores the result with SDV's evaluate_quality.
